title: AerCap Signs Lease Agreements with Turkish Airlines for Two Boeing 777-300ERSF Converted Aircraft

body_markdown:
DUBLIN


, Oct. 29, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- AerCap Holdings N.V. ("AerCap" or the "Company") (NYSE: AER) today announced that it has signed lease agreements with Turkish Airlines for two Boeing 777-300ERSF converted aircraft with deliveries scheduled between March and September 2027.


The aircraft will undergo conversion at the Etihad Engineering MRO hub in Abu Dhabi, enabling AerCap to serve customers efficiently across the wider EMEA region.


"We are delighted to continue supporting our long-standing partner, Turkish Airlines, with the addition of two Boeing 777-300ERSF aircraft to its fleet. These aircraft will provide Turkish Airlines with additional cargo capacity, combined with the outstanding performance capabilities of the 777-300ERSF," said **Peter Anderson, Chief Commercial Officer, AerCap** . "The dedicated 777-300ERSF conversion facility at Etihad Engineering's MRO hub in Abu Dhabi provides an important regional platform capability, enabling the aircraft to be converted in the Middle East ahead of delivery to Turkish Airlines. We thank Turkish Airlines for their enduring partnership and Etihad Engineering for their ongoing commitment to the program."


Following the delivery of its first Boeing 777-300ERSF converted freighter to launch customer Kalitta Air in September 2025, AerCap has continued to build momentum in the program, delivering aircraft to Fly Meta and signing lease agreements with Ethiopian Airlines and China Southern Group.


**About AerCap** AerCap is the global leader in aviation leasing with one of the most attractive order books in the industry. AerCap serves approximately 300 customers around the world with comprehensive fleet solutions. AerCap is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (AER) and has headquarters in Dublin and Miami and offices in Shannon, Memphis, Singapore, London, Dubai


, Shanghai, Amsterdam and other locations around the world.
